blocks.text:
To: Mary Frank
Cc: Michelle Rose

Thank you for turning the materials around so quickly. Read against the kickoff notes, they confirm we are aligned on where the {{fact:f:E-2017-001.client}} story needs to land, and the gaps you flagged are the ones we want to close first.

Michelle Rose is folding your comments into the working draft now. One request before it goes any further: let us hold the investor-facing lines until the internal narrative is settled, so nothing circulates ahead of your leadership review.
Could you send two or three windows this week for a thirty-minute walk-through of the messaging map? Send the times that work on your side and I will set it up.
